E9-01_real_tool_invocation.observation: MissionTaskAgent.execute() calls context.tool_executor.execute_tool('artifact_write', ...) which executes the tool implementation via Engine.execute_tool() -> SandboxManager.execute() -> artifact creation. Verified by production integration test showing action_id in task output.
E9-01_real_tool_invocation.evidence: E9-R/test_production_integration.py output shows action_id in task result; run_e9_fabric.py 17/17 pass; Engine.execute_tool() at src/unified/execution.py:2637-2840

E9-02_tool_contract_explicit.observation: 20 tool contracts defined with Pydantic input/output schemas, required_permissions, risk_level, isolation, timeout_seconds, retry_policy. All contracts registered in ToolRegistry.

E9-03_action_produced.observation: ToolExecutor.execute_tool() creates Action record at line 316-323, registers in both ToolExecutor._actions and Engine.actions. Action includes action_id, attempt_id, tool_name, tool_args, completed_at, success, output, error, evidence_id, sandbox_id.
E9-03_action_produced.evidence: src/unified/execution.py:316-360; production test shows 1 action with tool_name='artifact_write'

E9-04_action_linked.observation: Action linked via attempt_id to Attempt (which has task_id, agent_id). Attempt linked to Task (mission_id, run_id). Production test verifies action.attempt_id -> attempt.task_id == task_id and attempt.agent_id == reserved agent.
E9-04_action_linked.evidence: src/unified/execution.py:316-323; production test output shows attempt.task_id and attempt.agent_id

E9-05_workspace_sandbox_boundary.observation: artifact_write tool executes via Engine.execute_tool() -> SandboxManager.execute() with sandbox_id, resource limits, network_mode=NONE. Sandbox creates per-sandbox artifacts directory. Windows Job Objects enforce memory/CPU/process limits.

E9-06_unauthorized_rejected.observation: ToolExecutor._check_permissions() validates required_permissions against context.grant_ids via grant_validator. Fail-closed: no validator or missing grant -> PermissionError. Unit tests pass (E9-06). Production path would reject if grant_validator returns False.

E9-07_out_of_scope_rejected.observation: Filesystem tools resolve paths relative to workspace_root. Path traversal attempts would be caught by Path.resolve() and workspace boundary check. Unit test passes (E9-07).

E9-08_timeout_failure.observation: run_command tool returns non-zero exit code -> ToolResult.success=False. Task-level timeout in execute_task_graph_parallel -> asyncio.wait_for -> TimeoutError -> TaskState.FAILED. Unit test passes (E9-08).

E9-09_artifacts_persisted.observation: SandboxManager.execute() creates Artifact with artifact_id, path, sha256, size_bytes, mission_id. Stored in Engine.artifacts and FileEvidenceStore._artifacts. Artifact file written to sandbox artifacts directory.
E9-09_artifacts_persisted.evidence: src/unified/execution.py:2680-2720, 272-280; production test shows artifact in engine.artifacts

E9-10_evidence_verifiable.observation: EvidenceRecord created with evidence_id, evidence_hash (SHA256), content_type, source_id (artifact_id), mission_id, run_id, task_id. Stored in Engine.evidence and FileEvidenceStore._evidence. Hash verification on read detects tampering.
E9-10_evidence_verifiable.evidence: src/unified/execution.py:165-200; production test shows evidence with matching hash

E9-11_tampering_detected.observation: FileEvidenceStore.get_artifact_hash() and read_artifact_content() re-compute SHA256 and compare to stored hash. Mismatch -> tampering detected. Unit test passes (E9-11).

E9-12_human_gate_pauses.claim: Human gate pauses execution before governed action
E9-12_human_gate_pauses.observation: ToolExecutor._check_human_gate() checks risk_level HIGH/CRITICAL. Creates human gate via engine.create_human_gate(), stores gate_id in mission.metadata, raises PermissionError to pause. Mission state -> HUMAN_REQUIRED. Unit test passes (E9-12).

E9-13_human_reject_prevents.observation: engine.decide_human_gate(decision='reject') records decision, emits HUMAN_DECISION_REJECTED, mission state -> CANCELLED. ToolExecutor._check_human_gate checks for existing reject decision and raises PermissionError. Unit test passes (E9-13).

E9-14_human_approve_permits.observation: engine.decide_human_gate(decision='approve') records decision, mission state -> EXECUTING. ToolExecutor._check_human_gate sees approved decision for tool and allows execution. Unit test passes (E9-14).

E9-15_independent_verification.observation: Event bus history contains full chain: MISSION_STARTED, RUN_STARTED, TASK_CREATED, TASK_ASSIGNED, ACTION_REQUESTED, ACTION_VALIDATED, TOOL_COMPLETED, ARTIFACT_CREATED, EVIDENCE_RECORDED, VERIFICATION_COMPLETE, CHECKPOINT_CREATED. Independent process can read events/artifacts/evidence to reconstruct. Unit test passes (E9-15).
E9-15_independent_verification.evidence: src/unified/execution.py:137-153 (SimpleEventBus); run_e9_fabric.py TEST_E9_15_PASSED shows chain with 38 events

E9-16_no_mock.claim: No mock in production execution path
E9-16_no_mock.observation: MissionTaskAgent.execute() calls context.tool_executor.execute_tool() -> real ToolExecutor -> real Engine.execute_tool() -> real SandboxManager.execute() -> real WindowsExecutorAdapter -> real artifact file. No Mock classes, no stubs, no fake implementations in the production path. Previous bypass (sandbox.write_artifact direct call) eliminated.
E9-16_no_mock.evidence: src/unified/mission_controller.py:271-278 (before: direct sandbox call); src/unified/mission_controller.py:271-278 (after: tool_executor.execute_tool); production integration test proves path
